description: The calculated insights over the Room_Readings data model object (docs/DATA-CLOUD.md). scripts/data-cloud-insights.sh creates each one in an org's Data Cloud through the Connect REST API; the SQL can also be pasted into Data Cloud's calculated insight builder by hand. test/config/data-cloud-insights.test.js keeps the numbers in the SQL in step with config/<env>.json and the room-temperature rule. publishScheduleInterval is how often Data Cloud runs each one (One, Six, Twelve or TwentyFour hours): every run uses Data Cloud credits, so a daily count runs every 6 hours and only the last-reading check runs every hour.

insights.description: Per device and day: how many readings were at or above 30.0 C, the room-temperature rule's threshold, and about how many minutes that is at one reading every 30 seconds.
Per device: the time of its last reading in Data Cloud and its reading count. Minutes since and offline are worked out where it is read: an insight cannot use the current time after aggregating.
